request.request: Develop one practical weekday meal plan for one adult that uses the available ingredients, keeps active preparation within the stated limit, and arranges the selected meal components across the week.

context.context_summary: The plan covers five evening meals. The cook can batch-cook once and prepare one quick fresh component, then reuse them through Friday.
facts: The kitchen has a hob, oven, refrigerator and freezer.
Available staples include chickpeas, lentils, rice, pasta, tomatoes and seasonal vegetables.
The plan is for one adult from Monday through Friday.

constraints.text: Use at most ninety minutes of active preparation across the week.
Provide one complete evening meal for each weekday.
Refrigerated cooked food must be eaten within three days or frozen.

assumptions: The cook is willing to repeat a base component with different accompaniments.
unknowns: Exact seasonal vegetables and personal seasoning preferences are unspecified.
context.order_semantics: sequence in which the selected meal components are scheduled across the week
context.composition_guidance: Arrange the selected batch-cooked and quick fresh components into a safe five-day schedule, explaining reuse and storage without turning weekdays into gene dimensions.

criteria.text: The schedule fits the preparation, coverage and storage constraints.
The ordering creates useful weekday variety from the same components.
The five-day sequence and reuse decisions are easy to follow.
